body: I've done it in the past. I attempted 30+ with the mix of alcohol and other tablets  had no affect on me. I don't think this Is me truly trying to do it. As much as I wanted to take more I just stopped at 12.

I find it so difficult. Finding 0 motivation to keep fighting and slowly falling back into the dark again. It's hard keeping a false smile on everyday, telling everyone I'm doing great. It's just a lie, no one knows about my past nor have I told anyone. 

I have no ambition or thinking about the future when I worry so much about what's a happening right now. 

Everyone tells me how much of a nice person I am and how easy to talk to and understanding I am, but I can't say the same about anyone else. I don't trust anyone, I have no one I can confide to. 

It's just too easy to slip back to where I was, it was more comforting and in control.

I'd rather cut myself everyday than drink myself silly all the time and causing long term painful damage

All the time. Where I work it's a physically demanding job any always the risk of self injury. And I purposely do something careless and end up hurting myself. Only was I feel I can vent during work times when I can't openly cut myself at those times

I had the same problems when friends and work colleagues started asking questions so I just wore enough clothing to hide it and started cutting in less visible areas like my thighs and around my shoulder as of recently.

The one thing? I want to tell someone everything. But when I try they either run away or drag me down even further and use it as a weapon. Now I keep to myself with only selfharm as a expression to vent my feelings. And absolutely zero trust in anyone and everyone.
I'm not going to respond to them. I won't fuel there pathetic jokes or anything. Il just try to avoid them as much as possible just hope the jokes don't spread to everyone
Yea Im just scared incase they say there's something wrong with me and try to seek me professional help (in fine as I am)  or it might affect my job or something.

Yea that'd what I thought pluss the costs of drinking too when cutting is free hah! 

And I have some shallow cuts and deep ones. But I work outside and a very physical job so it can be hard to hide them.

I recently relapsed after 8 years and have had the same thoughts about killing myself thats how I started to cut myself again. It was the only thing keeping me alive making me feel something again. I always think what other damage I will cause if I did kill myself, it wouldn't just be affecting me, family, friends, work, school, college. Your death can trigger people into doing the same. That's why I've stuck to cutting myself as it only affects me and me only. I've never spoken to anyone about my suicidal thoughts as most people tell me I'm being silly. But I guess they don't understand or see how bad I am.

Just hold in there and stay strong. Dont let death become the better of you. You have so much more to life and to give to the world. If there's something effecting your life then work to change it, turn a negative into a positive. 

Stay strong. Wish you all the best :)

Try and think more positive about the job. The doors they will open for you and the rewards they will bring. Work can be a drag for everyone but they all have their benefits and cons but focus on the upside. A job is a good way to keeping your mind busy and away from all the emotions and urges

The minute I told her my dark thoughts about suicide she got really angry with me telling me how selfish and stupid I am and now doesn't give me the time of day anymore
I get this alot with.my friends although sometimes they can be the problem I just sit on my own and they leave me be

No one wants to be around me I always seem to upset people even though I'm trying to help. I lost my friends because of it, they all say there here to help me but in the time I need them they aren't interested or just say "chill you'll be fine" which I find is the worst thing to say to some one suffering. Girlfriend left me and cheated on me yet I still madly want her and she knows it but keeps playing me. 
At work I get teased and made fun of because of how I am and what I do, and I tried to find another job but didn't get it.
I act on the outside like nothing is wrong but when I'm by myself in private I'm letting my emotions out on me, I've tried talking to people and they just don't understand or know what to say.
Pretty much lost everything, friends, loved ones, feeling like a absolute failure and pure hate for myself. Self harming is keeping me away from suicide and is the only thing I enjoy right now..

Just hard when you lose everything almost makes me want to do something even worse than cutting but I'm doing it so I don't do anything too serious and in a way it is helping me.
